text: Token Usage Counter 是面向 DSH Web 的用量统计插件：它监听持久会话事件并将提供方报告的 token 用量保存到插件专属存储。它分别汇总输入、输出、缓存读取和缓存写入，并提供累计、按日、按会话及按提供方和模型查看的统计；Web 设置页展示总量、当天指标和活动热图。匹配完成事件后才计数，可把早期用量片段与最终消息对应起来。适合希望回顾 DSH 模型调用和 token 消耗的人；无需额外 API key，需使用 DSH 的会话、存储和 Web 服务。

Token Usage Counter is a DSH Web plugin for persistent token statistics. It stores provider-reported input, output, and cache usage, with cumulative, daily, per-session, and per-model totals. Its Web Settings panel shows totals and activity. It uses DSH session and storage services.

Token Usage Counter 的功能「多维用量汇总」：累计输入、输出、缓存读取和缓存写入 token，并按会话及提供方/模型归类。插件持续消费会话事件，统计可通过服务摘要接口读取。
Token Usage Counter 的功能「每日活动统计」：根据用量事件的本地日期汇总每日 token 和调用次数。Web 设置页以近期活动热图呈现每日分布，便于查看使用变化。
Token Usage Counter 的功能「Web 设置面板」：在 DSH 设置区域加入插件专属统计页，显示累计与今日指标、每日热图和模型统计。页面从同源只读快照接口刷新数据。
Token Usage Counter 的功能「完成后计数」：用量片段先暂存，并在对应 assistant 消息到达时确认；最终消息可替换同一步的早期样本，避免未完成请求被计入。

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Token Usage Counter for DeepSeek Harness：Persistent provider-reported token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. The
plugin keeps uncached input, cache read, cache write, and output usage in
separate buckets, and exposes cumulative, daily, per-session, and per-model
views.
section: Token Usage Counter for DeepSeek Harness

text:
dsh-token-usage-counter README · Features：| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Accurate buckets | Keeps the four provider-reported usage buckets separate. |
| Persistent totals | Stores data in the plugin-owned DSH storage domain. |
| Multiple views | Provides global, session, and provider/model summaries. |
| Daily activity | Tracks local-day token totals and call counts. |
| Built-in settings page | Ships its own Web settings view and heatmap. |
| Safe commits | Counts usage only after a successful completion anchor. |
| Interactive command | Registers /tokens when the commands service is mounted. |

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Install：To install this 0.5.0 source before an npm release, replace COMMIT with the
full 40-character commit of the reviewed revision:

dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:Mu-scorpio/token-usage-counter#COMMIT

The npm command installs the latest independently published version, which may
differ from this checkout:

dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-token-usage-counter
    dsh web

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Install：The Bundle is additive: it mounts only the plugin-owned token-usage-counter
entry and leaves the built-in usage accumulator and page enabled.

Version 0.4.0 moves persistence from the shared usage-stats namespace to the
plugin-owned dsh-token-usage-counter namespace. Existing 0.3.x totals are not
silently migrated because the shared namespace belongs to the built-in plugin;
the new counter starts with an independent snapshot after the upgrade.

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Install：Version 0.5.0 uses DSH's public storage-domain service for persistent data in
`dsh_token_usage_counter`, and serves a read-only aggregate snapshot to its
settings page through the existing DSH browser authentication. It does not
write statistics into Profile configuration forms. Legacy plugin-owned
settings data is not copied automatically; persisted session history can
rebuild the counter where the DSH session store still retains that history.
See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for permissions and evidence limits.

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Local development：From this checkout:

dsh web --patch ./cordis.yml

The local overlay mounts src/index.ts without replacing built-in components.
For a manual composition, add only the plugin-owned entry:

- insert:
        - id: token-usage-counter
          name: './src/index.ts'

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Compatibility：- Node.js: 22.13.0 or newer.
- Plugin 0.5.0: 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.2.1-alpha.1 and 0.2.1-alpha.2 passed isolated install, startup, persistence, authentication and uninstall checks. Older releases are unknown for this source.
- Profile: web.
- Exact per-release results and disposable-profile evidence are recorded in
  docs/VERIFICATION.md.

Store listing migration details: [docs/STORE-REMEDIATION.md](docs/STORE-REMEDIATION.md).

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Build：npm install --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps --no-package-lock
    npm run build
    npm run verify

Run a packed Bundle against an independently installed official DSH CLI:

npm run test:disposable -- /path/to/dsh/lib/bin.js /path/to/plugin.tgz

The generated host and client bundles are committed under lib.

dsh-token-usage-counter README · Counting rules：The plugin listens to the durable session event stream:

- assistant/message.usage is counted once.
- compaction/summary.usage is counted as one provider call.
- A usage-only assistant/chunk is held until its matching assistant/message.
- When a chunk and final message describe the same turn and step, the final
  value replaces the early sample.
- Failed requests, retries, and fork seed history are not counted twice.

dsh-token-usage-counter README · API：The plugin provides ctx.tokenUsageCounter:

ctx.tokenUsageCounter.getSummary()
    ctx.tokenUsageCounter.getSession(sessionId)
    ctx.tokenUsageCounter.getModel(provider, model)
    ctx.tokenUsageCounter.formatSummary()
